rows.definition: The explicit Go build tag selecting the experimental V4.1 BF16 boundary adapter and its software ABI and deferred physical tests. With the Vulkan tag it selects a separate native archive; combining it with the indexer witness tag is a compile-time error.
rows.distinction: This controls Go source and archive selection, whereas FAK_V41_BF16_BOUNDARY_WITNESS controls native symbol compilation and lfakvulkan_v41_bf16_boundary_witness names the linker input. The tag does not qualify hardware, enable ordinary production capability or remove host-boundary blockers.

rows.definition: The native compile-time define that exposes the experimental BF16 boundary C declarations and builds its checked dispatch, optional module admission and parser-test entry points into the dedicated witness archive. The Go adapter defines it for its C header declarations.
rows.distinction: This selects native declarations and implementation; the v41_bf16_boundary_witness Go tag selects the corresponding Go adapter. Its presence is an experimental build identity rather than physical qualification or a trusted production shader-registry promotion.

rows.definition: The exact cgo linker-option token selecting libfakvulkan_v41_bf16_boundary_witness.a for the BF16 witness-tagged Go build. All five Vulkan archive selectors choose this input exclusively for that tag combination, and an ordinary archive lacks the witness-only symbols.
rows.distinction: This names the linker input; it is separate from the Go build tag and native compile-time define. The option alone does not prove which archive bytes were linked: independently reviewed build commands and artifact hashes provide that evidence under immutable-artifact execution.
